# The pinned sources of the programs that the scripts under native/,
# spidermonkey/ and chromium/ build: name, version, URL and SHA-256, in the
# format of sources.txt. fetch.sh reads both lists and checks both alike.
#
# Each digest was recorded after the upstream signature verified: the GNU
# keyring for GDB; Mozilla's release key,
# 14F26682D0916CDD81E37B6D61B7B526D98F0353, for Firefox's source, whose signed
# SHA256SUMS lists the same digest; and the Rust release key,
# 108F66205EAEB0AAA8DD5E1C85AB96E6FA1BE5FE, for the Rust components. cbindgen's
# crate has no signature: its digest is the one the crates.io index lists,
# and the crate records the git revision from which Firefox's automation
# builds cbindgen. The Debian archive keys have the fingerprints ftp-master
# publishes, and Ubuntu's debian-archive-keyring package has the same ones.
